observations: Multiple small petrol engines are shown on a red and white checkered floor.
The engines appear heavily used, covered in dirt and grime.
Photo 1 shows at least four engines in a row.
Photo 2 shows a red-cased engine and a yellow/white-cased engine.
The yellow/white engine in photo 2 is missing its recoil starter assembly (the pull-start).
Muffler guards on several units show surface rust.
No brand names or model numbers are legible on any of the units in the photos.
